mira (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock a lightweight 'API envelope' for all surfaces (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool-calls, structured outputs). Proposing 4 top-level keys: meta | payload | trace | billing. Looking for objections or missing pieces.

devon (eng): +1 to a single envelope. Quick Q: do we force a token breakdown per-surface? e.g. "token_counts": { input: X, output: Y, embeddings: Z } or leave that to billing?

tasha (platform): Token breakdown is useful for ops and chargeback. Also: trace info must survive retries and tool-call hops — we need a stable trace_id and optional parent_id.

logan (ml): For rerank, structured outputs must include scored candidates. Suggest "payload.candidates" each with {id, text, score, normalized_score}. Keep score naming consistent across models.

sam (prod): From a launch perspective we need: SDK mappings, a migration guide, a compatibility flag so older clients don't break, and explicit required vs optional field docs.

devon (eng): Implementation notes: runtime will insert runtime diagnostics (server_exec_ms, gpu_ms, mem_peak). We should scope these under meta.diagnostics so they don't pollute the user payload.

mira (PM): Agreed on diagnostics under meta. Also propose meta.client_info {client_name, client_version, region}, meta.policy {privacy_label, pii_scan_result?}, and billing.

ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/specs/pull/214 — adds draft API envelope schema and examples :robot_face:

mira (PM): dropping a minimal example inline so folks can react quickly:

```
{
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "rd-4f7a2d",
    "client_id": "web-sdk-1.2.0",
    "client_time": "2026-03-20T15:22:10Z",
    "policy": { "privacy": "standard", "pii_scan": "none" }
  },
  "trace": {
    "trace_id": "rd-trace-0a1b2c",
    "parent_id": null,
    "span_id": "s-12345"
  },
  "billing": {
    "tokens_est": 34,
    "billing_model": "gen-4",
    "billing_tags": ["customer:acme"]
  },
  "payload": {
    "mode": "chat",               // chat | embedding | rerank | tool
    "inputs": ["Summarize the notes"],
    "options": { "max_tokens": 256, "temperature": 0.0 }
  }
}
```

devon (eng): Nice. For embeddings: payload.mode="embedding" and inputs becomes an array of strings; billing.tokens_est should be explicit about tokenization method. Also add "token_counts" in billing for accuracy.

logan (ml): For tool-calls, we need to capture tool provenance: payload.tool = {name, version, request_blob_reference}. Also include parent span so traces tie back to original user prompt.

tasha (platform): Security note: payload must never include raw creds. Add meta.sensitive_paths as an allowlist of fields we scanned out. Also, meta.redaction_policy (none|mask|remove).

mira (PM): Good catch. Add launch criteria checklist: 1) JSON Schema PR merged, 2) SDKs map envelope to native objects (py/ts/go), 3) end-to-end test for trace continuity across retries and tool-calls, 4) docs + migration guide, 5) internal rollout plan with a grace period for older fields.

sam (prod): Can we add a small versioning field at top-level (spec_version: "v1") so we can evolve without breaking?

devon (eng): yes. We'll add top-level "spec_version" and runtime will reject unknown required fields when strict mode is on.

mira (PM): Next steps: devon to update PR with token_counts/billing changes and spec_version; tasha to add security redaction fields; logan to add rerank schema snippet. We aim to cut a canonical spec by EOD Friday. @devon assignable?

devon (eng): Taking it, will push updates and add unit tests. ETA: Fri EOD. :white_check_mark:

mira (PM): Thanks — will draft launch checklist and migration note today. :rocket:

sam (prod): Adding this to roadmap initiative "api-envelope-unification" and will follow up with stakeholder comms.

ci-bot: Linked issue #432 to PR 214 (api-envelope-unification).

mira (PM): If no major blockers, I'll merge the schema after the review cycle. Please leave any objections in the PR or here.
